entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
entry.content:
node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements

Aliases: CVE-2026-33894, CVE-2026-85393, GHSA-ppp5-5v6c-4jwp

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • node-forge

node-forge through 1.4.0 fails to validate element count in nested DigestAlgorithm sequences during RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification. Attackers can embed garbage bytes inside the DigestAlgorithm sequence to forge valid signatures for arbitrary messages using low-exponent RSA keys. This is an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33894.
